claims.subject: PM motor power density and efficiency
claims.object: 5.8 kW/kg and 96% reported for state-of-the-art PM motors [41]; 5.3 kW/kg and 95% chosen
claims.statement: Kwak 2018 notes a maximum of 5.8 kW/kg and 96% efficiency reported for state-of-the-art PM motors [41] and chooses 5.3 kW/kg and 95% for its ElecPump analysis; inverter properties are assumed the same as in the preceding study [18].
claims.quote: In this study, a power density of 5.3 kW/kg and 95% efficiency were chosen

claims.subject: pump and turbopump power densities
claims.object: 20 kW/kg LOX pump and 15 kW/kg fuel pump from the authors' reference data; GG turbopumps 11-16 kW/kg, mean 13.5
claims.statement: For the ElecPump cycle Kwak 2018 takes 20 kW/kg for the LOX pump and 15 kW/kg for the fuel pump from the authors' research-group reference data; most LOX/kerosene GG turbopumps lie between 11 and 16 kW/kg with mean 13.5 kW/kg (standard deviation 1.5).
